reviews.title: Awesome oled panel
reviews.comment: I use this monitor for both work and personal use, and it’s been great for both. The ultrawide layout is super convenient for spreadsheets and multitasking. After work, I switch to YouTube or games, and the picture quality really shines. It’s a very well-rounded monitor.

reviews.title: Could Never go back to Multiple Monitors
reviews.comment:
I’ve sat with this monitor for a little bit now. Absolutely phenomenal. I’ve upgraded from having two 32” 1440p monitors to this one. I would NEVER go back. 

I don’t think I could possibly have another monitor now. 

I’m in IT and music production. The way this elevates workflows in both areas of work exceeded all my expectations
